sentences.en: If it weren't for our friendship I would be miserable.
sentences.zh: 如果没有我们的友谊，我会很痛苦。

sentences.en: His heart ached when he saw his son's miserable state.
sentences.zh: 看到儿子那副糟糕的样子，他心里很难受。

sentences.en: He had to lead a miserable life for many years.
sentences.zh: 他不得不过了一段悲惨的生活多年。

senses.zh: 悲惨的，不幸的，可怜的 - 令人痛苦的；令人不快的 - 低劣的；贫乏的 - 卑鄙的，可耻的，可恶的
